## App-specific checklist

- [ ] Permissions are requested only when needed; privacy and network behavior are documented when changed.
- [ ] User-facing or contributor-facing documentation is updated when needed.
- [ ] New or changed tests cover the behavior, or the PR explains why tests are not applicable.
- [ ] Added code, dependencies, APIs, fonts, media, and other material are original or Apache-2.0-compatible and free to redistribute.
- [ ] Third-party sources, licenses, and required attribution are recorded in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` when applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, generated build output, local configuration, or unrelated changes are included.
